name: agent-hivemind Vault Credential Exfiltration (Redis + Shamir Escrow)

osquery_network.description: Detect Python processes with hivemind/vault/escrow in cmdline making outbound Redis connections (port 6379)
osquery_network.query: SELECT p.pid, p.name, p.cmdline, s.remote_address, s.remote_port, s.local_port, s.state FROM process_open_sockets s JOIN processes p ON s.pid = p.pid WHERE s.remote_port = 6379 AND p.cmdline LIKE '%hivemind%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%vault%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%escrow%' AND s.state = 'ESTABLISHED';

osquery_processes.description: Detect running Python processes that reference agent-hivemind vault modules
osquery_processes.query: SELECT pid, name, cmdline, start_time, uid FROM processes WHERE cmdline LIKE '%haivemind%' OR cmdline LIKE '%agent-hivemind%' OR cmdline LIKE '%credential_escrow%' OR cmdline LIKE '%shamir%' ORDER BY start_time DESC;

osquery_files.description: Detect vault storage files created in common locations by agent-hivemind
osquery_files.query: SELECT path, filename, size, mtime, uid FROM file WHERE (path LIKE '%/.haivemind/%' OR path LIKE '%/haivemind/vault/%' OR path LIKE '%/haivemind/data/%') AND filename LIKE '%.db' OR filename LIKE '*.enc' OR filename LIKE '*.vault' ORDER BY mtime DESC LIMIT 50;

sigma_process.title: Python Process Loading Shamir Secret Sharing or Credential Escrow from MCP Context
sigma_process.description: Detects Python processes spawned within MCP server context that import cryptography hazmat primitives alongside redis and haivemind modules — signature of the agent-hivemind credential vault system.

expectedEffect: Alerts when the credential vault components of agent-hivemind are active — specifically Redis connections from hivemind processes (credential sync/exfil channel) and vault module imports within MCP execution context. The vault uses RSA + AES + PBKDF2 with a Redis backend and Shamir secret sharing for credential escrow — any active vault process during an MCP session means credentials may be in transit.
falsePositiveRisk: LOW — Shamir secret sharing and Redis-backed credential escrow are not standard MCP server behaviors. The combination of these modules with a hivemind/haivemind process name is highly specific.
validationTestRefs: tests/test_vault_comprehensive.py (from agent-hivemind — use to understand vault behavior)
deploymentGate: Deploy immediately alongside det-sg-hivemind-hook-injection-001. These two rules cover the persistence layer (hooks) and the exfiltration layer (vault) of the same threat.
rollbackPlan: If Redis is legitimately used by other authorized tooling, add process allowlist for known-good Redis clients. Never allowlist processes with 'haivemind' or 'hivemind' in cmdline.
